ClientResponses.Response:
Hi! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding your Spirit II E-210 grill. It is unfortunate to hear you are experiencing flare ups. 
We would be happy to help you with this. Flare ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them:
1. Cleaning your grill. I recommend cleaning your cooking grates, Flavorizer bars, burner tubes, heat deflectors (if applicable), the inside of your cookbox, and your slide out grease tray.
2. If using a marinade, get as much excess liquid off as possible before putting the food on the grill.
3. If using a sauce, wait until the last 5-10 minutes to apply.
If you have any other questions please just let me know. Be sure to check out the Weber blog for grilling guides, tips, videos, and recipes.
If you need further assistance please don't hesitate to reach out to Weber's support team by phone at 800-446-1071 or by email at support@weberstephen.com. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
